prose: **Current Status & History:** Emma Rose Callahan was born on March 22, 2010, and is currently 15 years old as of July 11, 2025. Her developmental history indicates that she has a complex background involving early trauma, adoption, and multiple placements. Despite having met most of her developmental milestones on time, she experienced some delays in walking, which occurred at approximately 19 months, and in speaking, with her first words emerging at around 2 years of age. Reports assert that Emma demonstrates academic weaknesses in math fluency, numerical operations, and written language, while also indicating she can write expository essays with at least 70% accuracy, and in some instances, at least 75% accuracy. At this time, Emma's behavior is described in various ways; she is reported to struggle with motivation in her classes, while other reports depict her behavior as adaptive and not an impediment to her learning.
